issue.title: Glossary preview card clips long definitions: auto scroll max-height:100% pushes the footer out of the card
issue.description:
Root cause: `GlossaryPreviewModal > Container` is `height: auto; max-height: 80%`, and its children are non-docked siblings: `#glossary-preview-title` (auto + margin-bottom 1), `#glossary-preview-scroll` (`height: auto; max-height: 100%`), and `#glossary-preview-footer` (auto + margin/border/padding). Textual resolves the scroll's `max-height: 100%` against the container's whole content height, ignoring the siblings. So when a definition is long, the scroll gets the full content height and pushes the footer out of the card.

Repro (Textual 8.0.1, headless): copy the GlossaryPreviewModal CSS block verbatim into a minimal ModalScreen that has a 2-line title Static, a VerticalScroll holding a 120-line Static, and a 1-line footer Static. Run it with `App.run_test(size=(120, 40))`. Result: the container region is y=4..36, but the scroll region is y=9..37 (it overruns the container's inner bottom at y=34), and the footer region starts at y=38, outside the card. The footer hints are invisible and the scroll's last lines are clipped. The same probe with the header docked (`dock: top`) fits exactly: short content stays compact and long content gets precisely the remaining rows. Found while planning the dictionary definition card, which uses the docked-hero fix.

Fix direction: dock the title (`dock: top`) and the footer (`dock: bottom`), or move the hints into `border_subtitle`. Then add a long-definition PNG snapshot (e.g. a glossary entry with a 60+ line definition at 120x40 and 70x24) proving the footer and the last definition line are visible.

task_type_fields.impact: Long glossary definitions lose their key-hint footer and the final lines of the definition become unreachable by scrolling.
task_type_fields.repro: Headless Textual 8.0.1 probe of the verbatim GlossaryPreviewModal CSS with a 120-line definition at 120x40: container y=4..36, scroll y=9..37, footer y=38 (outside the card). See description.

issue.creation_reason: Found while planning the dictionary definition card: a headless probe of the glossary card's exact CSS shows the footer and the last definition lines fall outside the card for long definitions.
